newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $941 mln in September's first week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $941 mln in September's first week.

text.p: Brazil exported $941 million in goods in the first week of September, with daily average exports at $188.2 million, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
A ministry spokeswoman said the first week's results compared with daily average exports of $216.5 million in the first two days of August.
Total August exports were $4.381 billion, averaging $199.1 million a day. The August trade balance was expected to be announced around the middle of September.
